scope: Bounded attempt to submit the approved synthetic json-check from a separately authenticated recipient Chrome session and observe tailnet-loss handling while a Kata task was active. The browser submission used a same-origin diagnostic POST through DevTools with the session CSRF token; it did not use the normal conversation UI. No task network access or model call occurred.

identity_and_fixture.recipient_identity: Previously verified USC Google OIDC identity in a separate Chrome incognito profile; identifiers omitted
identity_and_fixture.grant_permission: read three approved files and run only the fixed json-check action

capacity_release.change: Raised the global recorded-run cap from 24 to 32 so bounded browser-active validation could continue without deleting audit history.
capacity_release.service_unit_change: Only release and record hashes changed.

attempts.manual_root_recovery_and_resolution: Performed; exact synthetic run was inspected and resolved to failed/null with execution outcome unknown.

attempts.observer_failure: The observer raised EngineError during inspect-during-creation before the injected fault.

attempts.reason: Global recorded-run cap reached before cap32 deployment.

attempts.automatic_recovery: Failed with recovery_error_kind RuntimeError because already-dead tailscaled was mishandled.
attempts.manual_recovery_and_root_resolution: Performed; the exact synthetic run was root-inspected and resolved to failed/null with execution outcome unknown.

attempts.original_observer: observe_job_termination raised RuntimeError before its 30-second summary checks. No resource-disappearance timings or complete fail-close checks were recorded for this attempt.

delayed_relapse.observation: tailscaled logged PollNetMap unexpected EOF; the watchdog classified the host as offline and the service and tailscaled failed closed after the stability window.

final_recovery.first_manual_tailnet_recovery: Failed because WantRunning=true and ShieldUp=true after tailscaled started.

browser_state.submission_surface: Same-origin diagnostic POST issued in Chrome DevTools with the recipient session CSRF token; not the normal conversation UI.
browser_state.attempt_5_recipient_ui_after_grant_expir: Chrome incognito /review reload showed the landing text 'Open your current invitation link to enter its review workspace'; it did not show the workspace. The grant had expired naturally. No attempt-5 result visibility was checked after expiry, and this is not evidence of revocation.

local_validation.diagnostic_only_observer_patch_preflight: Refused after the delayed relapse; no new fault was injected.

limits: The feature result failed overall. Do not describe this as browser-active acceptance or pilot readiness.
The recipient submitted through a DevTools diagnostic POST, not the normal conversation UI.
The run used only the approved fixed synthetic json-check; no model call or task network access occurred.
A bounded disappearance observation does not prove a universal hard shutdown deadline.
The delayed tailnet relapse remains unexplained, and the same-second PollNetMap EOF is not established as its cause.
Attempt 4's bounded process/resource times were observed, but automatic recovery failed; attempt 5 lacked the observer's complete 30-second summary and has no recorded disappearance timings.
After the one-hour grant expired, /review returned the expected invitation landing page; no attempt-5 result visibility was checked after expiry.
No new grant was created; the one-hour grant expired naturally and was not renewed or revoked.
No hard SLA, broad safety claim, or pilot readiness is established.
privacy: No account identifiers, authentication links, credentials, private URL, run ID, container ID or transcript are included.
